python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sales Data']
print('Formulas in column H:')
for r in range(1, 11):
    print(ws.cell(row=r, column=8).coordinate, repr(ws.cell(row=r, column=8).value), '|', ws.cell(row=r, column=8).number_format)
print()
# Verify all margin denominators (Revenue) are non-zero to guarantee no #DIV/0!
revenues, profits = [], []
for r in range(2, 10):
    units = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    price = ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value
    cost = ws.cell(row=r, column=6).value
    rev = units * price
    profit = rev - units * cost
    revenues.append(rev); profits.append(profit)
    assert rev != 0, f'Zero revenue in row {r}'
    print(f'Row {r}: Revenue={rev}, Profit={profit}, Margin={profit/rev:.4f} ({profit/rev:.1%})')
tot_rev, tot_profit = sum(revenues), sum(profits)
assert tot_rev != 0
print(f'TOTAL: Revenue={tot_rev}, Profit={tot_profit}, Margin={tot_profit/tot_rev:.4f} ({tot_profit/tot_rev:.1%})')
print('No division-by-zero: all denominators > 0. All formulas valid.')
"
